component_definition: Within each shared gene and registered 128-um patch: shared=min(STAR,SR), STAR excess=max(STAR-SR,0), SR only=max(SR-STAR,0).

interpretation.registration_scope: coarse adjacent-section comparison; not cell-to-cell correspondence

parameters.cancer_cell_definition: listed Xenium graph cluster AND positive for at least one label gene
parameters.shape_normalization: log1p(10000 * counts / full shared-gene-axis patch mass)
